summary.text: Liz Berry is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 36-Position 2 since January 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Liz Berry lives in Queen Anne, Washington, and earned a B.A. from American University.
Her career experience includes working as the legislative director for former U.S. Representative Gabrielle Giffords.
Berry assumed office in the Washington House on January 11, 2021.
